missingReasons.no_bars: no stored daily bars on or before the day
missingReasons.no_benchmark: no SPY bars for the RS line
missingReasons.no_flat_base: no flat base ends at this day (base_catalog.flat_base_state found none)
missingReasons.not_enough_history: too few sessions for this window
missingReasons.not_in_screener_row: the nightly row holds no value for this column
missingReasons.patterns_current_window_only: confirmed pattern verdicts are kept for the current seven-day window only
missingReasons.patterns_unavailable: the confirmed-pattern store could not be read
missingReasons.rank_is_nightly_only: RS rank is a nightly universe rank and only the latest nightly is kept; a past day has none
missingReasons.series_contradicts_itself: withheld by the screener: the bar series reverses itself inside this window
